c14_capacity_certificate.risk_input_interpretation: tail-only rejection uses the prior risk budget boundary; c14 is rejected regardless because its observed multi-seed tail fails

c14_root_cause_diagnosis.historical_boundary: the original two slow rounds lacked component traces; this instrumented same-seed run diagnoses only reproduced behavior
c14_root_cause_diagnosis.runtime_queue_property: the runner allows at most one fixed-shape canonical batch per release round and waits before state commit; it has no cross-round verifier backlog

claim_boundaries: c14 remains rejected even if an instrumented rerun is faster
release round, not duplicated session event, is the tail unit
c12 threshold is calibrated in a disjoint process before five heldout processes
replay differences are separate from online authority violations
capacity evidence is contract-, hardware-, and workload-scoped

content.authoritative: the committed payload equals the online authoritative draw selected for that transition
content.risk_limited: fast-path state projection is bounded relative to the frozen authoritative contract by its statistical risk budget

guarantee.non_claim: RevTrace does not make nondeterministic inference deterministic and does not promise repeatability of a later independent draw

structural.claim: one result per parent version may commit, and session, contract, and policy epochs fence stale results
structural.name: version-linearized state mutation

reshape_tradeoff.boundary: same model, hardware, language, and 30-second synchronized workload; c14 and c12 use distinct independent seeds
